'''Cortosis swords''' or '''cortosis blades''' were edged [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] that were made of, or enhanced by [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]. Cortosis blades were made by a number of manufacturers and were widely available during the [[Jedi Civil War]] circa [[3956 BBY]], and were developed for a large number of reasons.

The first reason being that cortosis was capable of making many items [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] resistant when mixed with other ores or materials, in this way it found its way into many forms of [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Civil War. Another use was to make pure cortosis blades, which were used to short out a lightsaber for an advantage. Many times they were capable of shorting out a lightsaber for [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] at a [[Time/Legends|time]], and proved to be very effective.

A [[Trade Federation assassin droid|type of assassin droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] wielded cortosis swords to duel [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] destroyed many of the droids.

Before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] male [[Harll]] wielded a cortosis blade, given to him by the [[Morgukai]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]] used an cortosis blade against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Conclave on Kessel]]. Vader killed Potkin and used the blade against [[Jastus Farr]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
